about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a full-stack software engineer in Athens with about ten years of React/TypeScript on the frontend and PHP (Laravel, Yii) on the backend. I've built public platforms with real users: for almost four years I was the sole developer of a platform for the Greek Ministry of Maritime Affairs, and more recently I worked on the frontend of Lithuania's national tax portal.
about.p2: Outside work, I'm drawn to signals. I hold a diploma in Byzantine music and I'm building a classifier that recognises the mode of a hymn. For over a year I've been studying EEG processing and brain-computer interfaces, aiming at assistive technology for people with severe motor impairment.
